name: grp-mcp
description: Drive an Acumatica ERP instance from Claude: read, write, run processes and diagnose failures across the five APIs Acumatica actually has. Talks to your own instance directly - nothing is proxied, and credentials never leave your machine. Writes are off per profile until you enable them, and a clean 'ok' is never trusted: writes are read back and anything unconfirmed is reported as unverified. Runs on Windows, macOS and Linux through uvx, so it needs uv installed - 'winget install astral-sh.uv' on Windows, 'brew install uv' on a Mac. Run tools\Edit-Connections.cmd once to create your connections file; it lands in %USERPROFILE%\grp-mcp (~/.grp-mcp on macOS and Linux), outside AppData where a Claude app update cannot delete it, and the server finds it with no environment variable set. LATEST (0.81.0): the first version without an rc. Three things that went wrong without a word, found testing AP Invoice Processing, are fixed. A screen-API save that failed left its new row waiting, and the next save on that screen stored it (ten copies of one row, measured): such a row is now discarded. Clearing a field with null was refused because it was sent as the text 'None': null now clears it. A Yes/No question was answered 'OK', which it does not offer, so nothing ran while the call reported success: a question is no longer sent an answer it does not offer, and comes back with the answers it does. screen_get now says when there may be more rows than it returned. rc42's fix stands: a customization call on a slow site no longer keeps an API seat. Full history in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
